text: Take the grave-linen off a living man and let him walk home to dinner.
This was the last great sign before Jesus turned toward his own cross — and he did it in the open, at a marked grave, in front of a crowd, so that no one could ever call it a trick of the light.
The one who stands over every grave you have ever wept beside looked death full in the face and called a friend home.
He does not merely explain the resurrection.
